units.source_text: 我简直被当做一个普通单位的一个男人来对待。

en.t: I was treated simply as an ordinary man, one unit among others.

units.source_text: 我从未曾想像过谁能如此地接待我。

en.t: I had never imagined that anyone could receive me in such a way.

units.source_text: 结巴离我而去，丑陋和贫穷也离我而去。

en.t: My stutter left me, and ugliness and poverty left me as well.

units.source_text: 即使在脱衣之后，无数的脱衣重叠起来了。

en.t: Even after the undressing, countless acts of undressing seemed to pile one upon another.

units.source_text: 我的确达到了快感，但我无法相信我正在体味这种快感。

en.t: I certainly reached pleasure, but I could not believe that I was actually experiencing it.

units.source_text: 在遥远的地方，涌起了使我异化的感觉，旋即又崩溃了……

en.t: Somewhere far away, a feeling that estranged me from myself welled up, then immediately collapsed again...

units.source_text: 我的身子马上离开她，把领头贴在枕头上，用拳头轻轻地敲了敲冰凉而麻痹了的脑袋。

en.t: My body at once drew away from her, pressed my head against the pillow, and lightly tapped my cold, numb head with my fist.

units.source_text: 然后，我被某种感觉所袭击，我仿佛被万物所遗弃，但还不至于涌出泪水来。

en.t: Then I was struck by a certain feeling, as if I had been abandoned by everything, though not yet enough to bring tears welling up.
